subject: POC readiness: gates, owners, and target close
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Zhou <alex.zhou@finlytics.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: POC readiness: gates, owners, and target close

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I’m attaching a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused just on the POC environment gates so we can align on owners and timelines. Key milestones I captured:

- Milestone A: VPC peering / routing confirmed (owner: Finlytics network) — dependency: target IP ranges and CIDR overlap check
- Milestone B: IP allowlist + firewall rules applied (owner: Finlytics IT) — dependency: list of egress IPs and expected port ranges
- Milestone C: SSO / SAML integration (owner: Finlytics identity) — dependency: IdP metadata and test user
- Milestone D: Secrets & KMS access (owner: Redwood / Finlytics security) — dependency: KMS key policy + service account ARNs
- Milestone E: Smoke tests & access validation (owner: Redwood + Finlytics) — dependency: test vectors and scheduled window

Proposed target for completing these gates and starting the POC: 2026-12-10 (we can compress or expand based on your availability).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Alex / Priya: confirm owners and an initial time window for VPC peering (we typically need a 1-hour maintenance window).
2) Finlytics IT: share the IP allowlist you’d like us to use and any proxy/firewall rules that will block outbound connections.
3) Finlytics identity: send SAML metadata + a test user so we can validate assertion flows in our staging tenant.
4) Marissa / Karthik: I’ve asked you to prepare the short KMS/role guidance we discussed (see attachment).

Attaching: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (actionable checklist), network-diagram.png (high-level), sso-kms-implementation-notes.docx (internal guidance).

If helpful, we can do a short 30-min tech alignment tomorrow to walk the network steps.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference

Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finlytics.com>, Finlytics IT <it-ops@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC readiness: gates, owners, and target close

Sean — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. Quick answers / clarifications from our side: 

- Owners: I’ll own the VPC peering coordination with our cloud infra team (cc’d). Priya will own IdP/SAML. Finlytics IT will manage firewall/IP rules.
- VPC peering window: we have a maintenance block on 2026-12-07 between 02:00–04:00 UTC; can that work for your engineers?
- IPs: our egress is NATed through 34.82.10.0/24 and 35.194.200.0/24. We’ll confirm if additional ranges are needed.
- SAML: Priya, can you share metadata and a test user (preferably SAML NameID=email)?

Couple of questions:
1) For KMS access, what audit events are you expecting? We need to confirm which principals will be allowed to decrypt.
2) If we have an internal proxy that performs TLS inspection, is there a recommended way to allowlisting without exposing certs?

Happy to do the 30-min alignment tomorrow if your team is available.

—Alex
Alex Zhou, Head of Platform Engineering | Finlytics
alex.zhou@finlytics.com

- Karthik: can you draft the minimal IAM/KMS role doc (one page) listing: principal ARNs we need, required KMS encryption/decrypt permissions, and recommended key policy lines? I’ll attach that to the MAP and send to Finlytics.

- If the 2026-12-07 maintenance window is the only option for the peering, confirm with infra and we’ll prioritize that. Otherwise propose 2026-12-08 02:00–03:00 UTC as an alternate.

Subject: Re: POC readiness: gates, owners, and target close

Alex / Priya —

Appreciate the rapid responses and ownership confirmation. Short updates and final asks before I mark the MAP as "active":

- VPC peering: 2026-12-07 02:00–04:00 UTC is fine for our infra; we’ll schedule an engineer to be on the call and perform routing validation.
- IP allowlist: noted the two NAT blocks. Finlytics IT, please confirm if you need any additional ports opened outbound (we use 443 for control plane and 5235 for streaming diagnostics by default).
- KMS/audit: Karthik and I will prepare a one-page KMS principal list (expected principals: redwood-infra@redwood-service-account, seans-connector@redwood) and the minimal CloudKMS decrypt role. Expect that doc by EOD tomorrow.
- SAML: Priya — once you share metadata and a test user we will run auth flow validation in our staging account; please also confirm whether your NameID is email or persistent.

Target milestone dates (updated):
- All network/IP gates closed: 2026-12-07 (post-maintenance window)
- SAML validation complete: 2026-12-08
- KMS/principal policy agreed: 2026-12-09
- POC smoke test start: 2026-12-10
- Target POC completion / decision: 2026-12-17

I’ll update and re-attach the MAP after Karthik’s KMS note. If any of these dates are impossible for you, flag which ones and we’ll reprioritize.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
